create_llama_config_defaults: create a LlamaConfig instance with default parameters for a LLaMA-7B style model
create_llama_config_custom: create a LlamaConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads values
configure_llama_gqa: configure a LlamaConfig with num_key_value_heads less than num_attention_heads for Grouped Query Attention
configure_llama_rope_scaling: configure a LlamaConfig with rope_scaling dict to use linear or dynamic RoPE embedding variants
configure_llama_quantization: configure a LlamaConfig with w_bits parameter to set quantization bit width for the model
